_comment: PICK YOUR POISON: most events offer the SAME three choices in the same order — spend TIME (slow, safe), spend CREW (power through), or spend BIKES (send it). No option is ever 'best'; you pick based on which bar you can spare. Opportunity events instead let you skip or grab a reward for a cost. Kept consistent + numberless on purpose so kids learn the pattern.

events.title: Flat Tire!
events.description: One of the bikes has a flat. What now?

choices.text: Everyone pitches in for a fast fix
Take your time to fix it right
Force it back together and go
Grind on with the loose chain

events.title: Bent Wheel!
events.description: Someone clipped a curb and the wheel wobbles badly.

events.title: Deer in the Road!
events.description: A deer bolts right across your path.

events.title: Dog Chase!
events.description: A big dog is chasing the whole crew.

choices.text: Pedal like crazy to lose it

events.title: Rainstorm
events.description: The sky opens up and rain pours down.

choices.text: Wait it out under a tree

events.title: Heat Wave
events.description: The afternoon sun is absolutely brutal.

choices.text: Rest in the shade a while
Grit it out and hold the pace
Race hard to the next shade

events.title: Fierce Headwind
events.description: A hard wind shoves you backward.

choices.text: Ease off and wait for a lull
Tuck low and hammer the pedals

events.title: Construction Zone
events.description: The road ahead is completely torn up.

choices.text: Carry the bikes across on foot

events.title: Big Hill
events.description: A steep hill looms with no way around.

choices.text: Grind up it in the saddle
Attack it standing (hard on the bikes)

events.title: Junk in the Road!
events.description: Broken glass and screws cover the road.

choices.text: Hop off and walk it through

events.title: Officer on Patrol
events.description: A police officer waves you down. No sidewalk riding!

choices.text: Duck down the bumpy back alley

events.title: Nosy Neighbor!
events.description: Mr. Henderson is already reaching for his phone.

events.title: Shortcut!
events.description: A path through the park could cut off a big chunk.

choices.text: Stay on the safe main road

events.title: Big Downhill!
events.description: A long hill you can coast down — or bomb.

choices.text: Coast easy and let everyone rest
Let it roll for good speed

events.title: Water Fountain!
events.description: A working fountain by the park. Everyone's parched.

events.title: Lucky Find!
events.description: A crumpled bill on the side of the road.
